text: やまおくで　しゅぎょう　したのに　…　なさけない

structure.jp: やまおくで　しゅぎょう　したのに　…
structure.en: even though I trained deep in the mountains...

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに after a verb means 'even though', with a feeling of disappointment that things turned out otherwise. しゅぎょう　したのに = 'even though I trained'.
